bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to energy; appropriating money for an ammonia, hydrogen, and renewable energy certificate tracking system; requiring reports.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; AMMONIA, HYDROGEN, AND RENEWABLE ENERGY CERTIFICATE TRACKING SYSTEM. +]

[+(a) $9,000,000 in fiscal year ..... is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to the Midwest Renewable Energy Tracking System for technology that enables tradable ammonia, hydrogen, and renewable energy certificates. +]

[+(b) Beginning January 1, 2026, and through January 1, 2030, an entity that receives a grant under this section must submit a report to the Legislative Auditor that details how the grant money received has been spent. +]

[+(c) Beginning January 1, 2030, and through January 1, 2035, an entity that receives a grant under this section must report to the commissioners of commerce and agriculture regarding the number of green ammonia certificates issued in Minnesota as a result of the grant money received. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to energy; appropriating money for an ammonia, hydrogen, and renewable energy certificate tracking system; requiring reports.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; AMMONIA, HYDROGEN, AND RENEWABLE ENERGY CERTIFICATE TRACKING SYSTEM.

(a) $9,000,000 in fiscal year ..... is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to the Midwest Renewable Energy Tracking System for technology that enables tradable ammonia, hydrogen, and renewable energy certificates.

(b) Beginning January 1, 2026, and through January 1, 2030, an entity that receives a grant under this section must submit a report to the Legislative Auditor that details how the grant money received has been spent.

(c) Beginning January 1, 2030, and through January 1, 2035, an entity that receives a grant under this section must report to the commissioners of commerce and agriculture regarding the number of green ammonia certificates issued in Minnesota as a result of the grant money received.

(c) Beginning January 1, 2030, and through January 1, 2035, an entity that receives a grant under this section must report to the commissioners of commerce and agriculture regarding the number of green ammonia certificates issued in Minnesota as a result of the grant money received.
